args.title: Fix quoted header parsing in src/ingest/parser.ts
args.body:
src/ingest/parser.ts

The header line is parsed with simple comma-splitting (`lines[0].split(",")`) instead of `splitFields(lines[0])`. When bank exports include double-quoted column names in the header (e.g. `"Date","Amount"`), the literal quotes remain part of the header strings, causing subsequent row validation against REQUIRED_COLUMNS and column count checks to fail.

We propose updating `parseStatement` to parse the header line using `splitFields(lines[0])` so that surrounding quotes are properly stripped from header names.
